name: Gao tam Hai Hau
summary: Gạo tám Hải Hậu is the fragrant rice the Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 says to eat with kho meat, or with peanuts and sesame. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 describes gạo Tám xoan Hải Hậu as a long, slender, slightly bent grain, translucent green, not chalky, mildly fragrant, and chewy when cooked. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Hải Hậu, Nam Định. Báo Nam Định on 30 January 2023 says gạo tám xoan Hải Hậu was chosen for a Top 100 of Vietnamese gift specialties. Gạo tám Xuân Đài is a separate name.
texture: Dân Việt on 15 April 2025: the grain is a little long, slender, bent at one end, translucent green, and not chalky in the belly. The aroma is mild and natural. Cooked rice is white, chewy, elastic, and fragrant. The same article says the variety has been selected locally for nearly 200 years, on flat alluvial land at the river mouth, and that protein depends on how the field is watered.
howToEat: As cooked rice. The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 pairs it with kho meat, or with peanuts and sesame. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 says it is kept for lễ, Tết, and gifts. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Hải Hậu. A shop door was not printed. Check on arrival.
